description:
Join the Ulike Glow Partner affiliate program today – your beauty partner for effective and long-lasting at-home hair removal.

Brand & Expertise: Ulike is an IPL specialist with a decade of research, over 800 patents and innovation in professional hair removal and unparalleled skin protection, revolutionizing at-home hair removal routines.

Ulike generated 1.3 billion in revenue in 2023, employs over 1,800 people, and already has 7 million devices delighting customers worldwide.

Ulike prioritizes quality over quantity – launching only a few models per year. Each device is meticulously researched, tested, and improved. Every new version incorporates real customer feedback and the latest technological trends for continuous refinement.

Unique Selling Point (USP): The Ulike Air 10 is our iconic IPL hair removal device with patented Sapphire Ice Cooling technology.

  • Up to 24 months of smooth skin 
  • Removes coarse, stubborn hairs 
  • 96% hair reduction in just 2 weeks 
  • 10-minute full-body sessions 
  • SGS-certified safety & nearly painless 
  • Tough on hair, gentle on sensitive skin

Compensation Terms: You earn a 10% commission on every sale made via your link or promo code.

Resources & Support: Access to a media library (banners, visuals, tutorial videos) and dedicated support to boost your performance.

If you’re interested, please feel free to contact us directly by email. We look forward to hearing from you and working together.

The Ulike Team
